title: Benchmark Prompt Diversity Scorer: Measuring Semantic Redundancy Within Safety Evaluation Sets

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Addresses benchmark quality at a meta level. If benchmarks contain redundant prompts, coverage claims are inflated. Diversity scoring could become a standard quality check. Solid infrastructure contribution.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Sentence-transformers run on CPU. Pairwise similarity and clustering are standard Python operations. No model training, no GPU needed beyond embedding computation. Highly accessible for beginner CS students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Well-scoped: embed prompts, compute similarity, cluster, report diversity scores. 3 benchmarks is manageable. The main time cost is data collection and formatting. Easily achievable in 30 hours.
